{{Top|leg}}
The '''Horos Spine''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran from the [[Horos system/Legends|Horos system]].

The [[Horos Spine Incident]] resulted in the [[Ando separation|secession]] of [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].
